summary: FileShare Portal comprehensive testing completed. All backend APIs passed (22/22). Frontend features working correctly including login, hub navigation, fileshare with storage tabs, admin user management with password management, forgot password flow with MOCKED email (returns token directly), and reset password flow.
passed_tests: Login page: Shows 'Eventenergie Portal' with fuchsia button, 'Passwort vergessen?' link navigates to /forgot-password
Login flow: admin@test.com/password logs in successfully and redirects to /hub
Hub page: Shows FileShare and Benutzerverwaltung cards for admin user
Dashboard/FileShare: 'Mein Bereich' and 'Gemeinsamer Bereich' tabs work, 'Neuer Ordner' opens CreateFolderModal
Admin page: Users table displays correctly with columns (Name, E-Mail, Rolle, FileShare, Status, Aktionen)
Admin password management: Key icon opens password modal with 'Neues Passwort setzen' and 'Reset-Link generieren' options
Forgot password: /forgot-password renders correctly, submits email, shows demo reset link (MOCKED)
Reset password: /reset-password/:token validates token, allows password reset with confirmation
Backend: All 22 API tests passed including auth, user management, password reset, folders, files, shares, stats
critical_code_review_comments: Security: password_plain field stored in MongoDB when admin sets password (intentional per requirements, but flagged)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test data prefixed with TEST_ is cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major features tested and working. Login, hub, fileshare, admin, password reset flows all functional. Password reset email is MOCKED - returns reset_token in response body for demo purposes. fuchsia/magenta theme applied correctly. German UI throughout.
